metric: non-free gates = AND/OR-class gates (GateCount::nonfree_gate_count) = GarbleMode ciphertexts; XOR/NOT free. Constants folded.

keccak_f1600.construction: keccak256 (repo, src/nova/transcript.rs) on an 8-byte message = exactly 1 rate block = 1 Keccak-f[1600] permutation; 24 rounds x 1600 chi ANDs, theta/rho/pi/iota free; padding/xor-absorb add no AND

sha256_compress.construction: 64 rounds + 48 schedule steps; ripple 32-bit adders (31 AND each, K folded as constant), Ch = g^(e&(f^g)) and Maj = a^((a^b)&(a^c)) at 32 AND each; 7 adds/round, 3 adds/schedule word, 8 final feed-forward adds
sha256_compress.test_vector_source: sha2 crate compress256, 64 random (chaining value, block) pairs

blake3_compress.construction: 7 rounds x 8 G, 6 32-bit adds per G (56*6*31 = 10416 nominal; measured 6 fewer from constant folding of the constant state words); counter/block_len/flags are circuit constants (0, 64, CHUNK_START|CHUNK_END|ROOT); outputs all 16 words
blake3_compress.test_vector_source: blake3 crate hash() of 64-byte messages (cv=IV trials) plus native reference with random cv, 64 trials

koalabear_mul_mod.construction: 31x31 -> 62-bit via repo bigint mul (1702 AND) + Barrett reduction 366 AND (mu=floor(2^62/p) shift-add with folded zeros, r = x + (q<<24) - (q<<31) - q mod 2^34, two conditional subtractions of 2p and p)
koalabear_mul_mod.test_vector_source: native u128 mod p; edge values plus random, >=64 pairs; Barrett model checked on 4M inputs (<=2 corrections)

babybear_mul_mod.construction: same as KoalaBear with k=27; reduction 459 AND (denser mu)

koalabear_add_mod.construction: 32-bit add (31 AND) + conditional subtract p (32 AND carry chain + 31 mux)

koalabear_ext4_mul.construction: schoolbook in F[X]/(X^4-3): 16 mul_mod, 12 add_mod, 3 mul_by_3 (applied to summed wrapped terms); 16*2068+12*94+3*159
koalabear_ext4_mul.test_vector_source: native schoolbook u128, 64 random + all-(p-1) cases

babybear_ext4_mul.construction: schoolbook in F[X]/(X^4-11): 16 mul_mod, 12 add_mod, 3 mul_by_11; 16*2161+12*94+3*328
babybear_ext4_mul.test_vector_source: native schoolbook u128, 64 random + all-(p-1) cases
